title: messaging.py _bound_oscore_identity unbounded recursion
description: Lines 109-110 in python/src/lichen/coap/resources/messaging.py recursively call _bound_oscore_identity(durable()) when value has a callable durable_context_id attribute. If the returned object also has this method and creates a cycle (e.g., returns self), infinite recursion results in stack overflow. While unlikely in practice (requires malformed OSCORE context object), adding a recursion depth limit would be defensive. Not externally exploitable since OSCORE context is set by internal aiocoap processing.
